archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-contract
archetypes.rationale: Changed research orchestration prose now depends on bgjob result-env gates and unique lane slugs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed /research prompt references and structure harness for bgjob contract fidelity. Focus on whether each external lane has a unique step slug, truncates its merge env before start, waits on the matching slug, and gates continuation on BGJOB_RC plus required result-env keys. Also check that Claude Agent fallback behavior remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
